content.title: Schedule of Events
content.summary: The Arvada Festivals Commission organizes various community events throughout the year, including Arvada Winterfest, the Arvada Kite Festival, and High Tea for Seniors. Key events for 2026 include Winterfest on February 28, the Kite Festival on April 12, Summerfest on June 6, and Independence Day fireworks on July 4, along with Movies Around Town from July to October and High Tea for Seniors on August 8.
content.body:
The volunteer-led Arvada Festivals Commission hosts several community events throughout the year, including Avada Winterfest, the Arvada Kite Festival, High Tea For Seniors and Movies Around Town.

## 2026 Schedule of Events

1. [Saturday, February 28: Arvada Winterfest](#tab8fd406a0-f347-4114-bc74-62f04892acfd_0)

Arvada Winterfest is a multicultural celebration with live performances, music, vendors, food, and more. Come on out and celebrate the diversity of cultures in our community in the heart of Olde Town Arvada! [![Arvada Winterfest Saturday, Feb. 28, 2026 in Olde Town Arvada](/ImageRepository/Document?documentId=6666)](https://www.arvadaco.gov/496/Arvada-Winterfest)

- Date: Saturday, February 28, 2026
- Location: Olde Town Square Arvada
- Visit the Winterfest webpage for more details.

![Group performing traditional Chinese dragon dance outdoors, wearing green tops and red furry pants, with colorful dragon figure raised on poles.](/ImageRepository/Document?documentId=4916)

1. [Sunday, April 12: Arvada Kite Festival](#tab8fd406a0-f347-4114-bc74-62f04892acfd_1)

Soaring fun for the whole family: Don't miss the spectacular Arvada Kite Festival! Whether you’re flying or watching kites, get outside with your family and enjoy all of the exciting outdoor activities the festival has to offer! [![Arvada Kite Festival logo](/ImageRepository/Document?documentId=2626)](/1245)

- Date: Sunday, April 12 from 10 a.m. to 3 p.m.
- Location: Stenger Sports Complex
- [Visit the Arvada Kite Festival page](/1245) for more information

![Man flying a colorful kite in the park](/ImageRepository/Document?documentId=4924)

1. [Saturday, June 7: Arvada Summerfest](#tab8fd406a0-f347-4114-bc74-62f04892acfd_2)

Arvada Summerfest is our community's premier summer kick-off celebration featuring live music, pet-friendly fun and free kids activities!

- Date: Saturday, June 6, 2026
- Location: Ralston Park Addition (64th Ave. and Simms St.)
- Visit the Arvada Summerfest webpage for more information

1. [Friday, July 4: Independence Day Fireworks](#tab8fd406a0-f347-4114-bc74-62f04892acfd_3)

The City of Arvada hosts its annual Fourth of July fireworks display at Stenger Sports Complex, 11200 W 58th Ave.

- Date: Friday, July 4, 2025; fireworks start at approximately 9 p.m.
- Location: Stenger Sports Complex
- Visit the [Fourth of July Fireworks page](https://www.arvadaco.gov/494) for more information

![](https://www.arvadaco.gov/ImageRepository/Document?documentId=2630)

1. [July - October: Movies Around Town](#tab8fd406a0-f347-4114-bc74-62f04892acfd_4)

Join your family and friends for free outdoor movies on Friday nights throughout the summer. Movies are shown on our giant inflatable movie screen at different Arvada parks each month.

Visit the [Movies Around Town page](/1260) for more information.

![People in lawn chairs watching an outdoor movie in a park ](/ImageRepository/Document?documentId=4926)

1. [Saturday, August 8: High Tea For Seniors](#tab8fd406a0-f347-4114-bc74-62f04892acfd_5)

High Tea for Seniors started has grown into an amazing crowd of energetic and outgoing seniors (90 years young) that attend year after year. Wear your fancy attire and/or your favorite hat and come join us for tea, hors d'oeuvres and live music.

![High Tea for Seniors logo](https://www.arvadaco.gov/ImageRepository/Document?documentId=2628)

- Saturday, August 8 from 1 to 3 p.m.
- Location: Apex Community Recreation Center

![people enjoying afternoon tea at a High Tea for Seniors event ](/ImageRepository/Document?documentId=2711)

## Other Events and Festivals in Arvada

Arvada is home to many other wonderful community festivals and events that celebrate culture, food, and fun. Here are links with information about events in the city hosted by other organizations:

- [Olde Town Arvada](https://www.oldetownarvada.org/)
- [Arvada Visitors Center](https://www.visitarvada.org/events#/)
